column2: 109 segregant strains from a cross between the parental strains were grown in two conditions
column3: Two parental strains (BY and RM, see Materials and Methods ) and 109 segregant strains from a cross between the parental strains were grown in two conditions—glucose and ethanol as carbon sources—and expression profiled using microarrays.

column2: 3,997 and 3,489 linkages were observed in glucose and ethanol
column3: We performed linkage analysis on the transcript levels within each condition, and 3,997 and 3,489 linkages were observed in glucose and ethanol, respectively ( Figure S1 and Table S4 ).

column2: subjected to linkage analysis with 2,894 markers
column3: The difference between conditions was calculated for each segregant for 4,482 transcripts with high-quality data (see Materials and Methods ), and subjected to linkage analysis with 2,894 markers spaced throughout the genome.

column2: There were 1,382 transcripts that showed gene–environment interaction with at least one locus
column3: There were 1,382 transcripts that showed gene–environment interaction with at least one locus (total of 1,555 linkages) at a genome-wide 5% false discovery rate (FDR), as determined by permutation (see Figure 3 for an example).

column3: gxe QTL were less likely to be local, with 172/1,555 (11%) of all gxe QTL being local, as compared to linkages within either condition, where 22%–25% of all linkages were local ( Table 1 ).

column3: The majority of distant linkages fell into bins with a significant excess of linkages, with 81% (1,126/1,383) of distant gxe QTL occurring in 31/563 bins, or 5.5% of the genome.

column3: Significant bins that were located immediately next to each other were merged into a single peak to form 13, 13, and 15 peaks for glucose, ethanol, and gxe QTL, respectively ( Figure 4 and Table S1 ).

column3: Allele replacements of DIG1 in both backgrounds show that variants in DIG1 make a major contribution to the effects at this locus ( Figure S3 ).

column3: Comparisons of gxe QTL with linkage results for transcript levels in glucose or ethanol showed that only 965/1,555 (62%) gxe QTL also reached genome-wide significance levels in at least one condition (see Figure S2 B for full Venn diagram).

column2: All 1,555 gxe QTL showed an effect in at least one condition
column3: All 1,555 gxe QTL showed an effect in at least one condition, with 265/1,555 (17%) showing an effect only in glucose, 327/1,555 (21%) showing an effect only in ethanol, and 963/1,555 (62%) showing an effect in both conditions.

column2: 546/1,383 (40%) of distant linkages were significant in only one condition
column3: Distant linkages were significantly more likely to be condition specific than local linkages, as 546/1,383 (40%) of distant linkages were significant in only one condition, as compared to 46/172 (27%) of local linkages ( Table 2 and see Figure 5 for a schematic).

column2: A total of 372 transcripts link here distantly
column3: A total of 372 transcripts link here distantly, and many are generally involved in energy metabolism and growth ( Figure 7 A).
